title: MemorySubjectsFenceResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "subject_id": string, "status": string, "fenced_contexts": string[], "revision": int }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.subjects.fence (§7.7): INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION, INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED, SPACE_FROZEN. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
